clips.title: The story
paras: Wendigo packs make their lair in Grizzled Den, southwest of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

Grizzled Den cuts into the crags southwest of Kharanos, where Dun Morogh’s wendigo packs make their home. These aggressive, ape-like beasts breathe frost at intruders and band together to defend their hollows. Hunters brave the cavern for the thick wendigo manes, which craftsmen use to line cold chairs and carriage seats with insulated fur.

Prospectors enter Grizzled Den to work copper veins in its frozen stone walls, and scouts search its darker corners for discarded footlockers. The deeper tunnels hold the den’s largest and most vicious predators, waiting in the shadows.
